config answers with the effective configuration: every setting, with the
values the configuration file declares over the defaults. The file is
release.toml or config/release.toml at the repository root, or the one
--config names. Exits 2 when the configuration is refused.

Usage:
  release config [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for config
      --json   Render the answer as JSON instead of YAML

Global Flags:
      --config file   Use this configuration file instead of discovering one
  -C, --repo path     Operate on the repository at this path instead of the working directory
